News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:54:58 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>The 51%</category><title>How will the women's vote shape the US midterms?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-51/20261030-how-will-the-women-s-vote-shape-the-us-midterms</link><description>
With the US midterms approaching, we examine the power of the women's vote in an election that will shape the balance of power in Washington during Donald Trump’s final two years in office. Annette Young talks to Annie Karni, congressional correspondent for The New York Times and Kelly Dittmar, Director of Research at the Centre for American Women and Politics.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/5e8dc1a2-d465-11f1-bafa-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/web-photo-51-percent-midterms.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/5e8dc1a2-d465-11f1-bafa-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/web-photo-51-percent-midterms.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ed2bea6e-d466-11f1-bc3d-417feb7fc806</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:52:51 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Annette YOUNG</dc:creator></item><item><category>Technology</category><title>How the record-breaking $6.3 billion heist in crypto history unfolded</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261030-how-the-record-breaking-6-3-billion-heist-in-crypto-history-unfolded</link><description>
Hackers stole $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance in a record-breaking heist, prompting issuers to freeze roughly half of the stolen assets. The breach, which US analysts suspect was done by North Korean hackers, has shaken confidence in the crypto market.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ce79d554-d452-11f1-98a4-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/Binance-2.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ce79d554-d452-11f1-98a4-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/Binance-2.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d066979a-d465-11f1-b3f7-317d0b2acc30</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:52:44 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ce79d554-d452-11f1-98a4-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/Binance-2.jpg">© Dado Ruvic, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Revisited</category><title>Georgia's European dream left in limbo</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/revisited/20261030-georgia-s-european-dream-left-in-limbo</link><description>
Two years ago in Georgia, tens of thousands of pro-European protesters rallied against the disputed results of the October 2024 parliamentary election, which was officially won by the ruling Georgian Dream party. A few weeks later, the authorities announced the suspension of the country's European Union accession process. Despite an ongoing crackdown, smaller-scale protests continue every day in the capital Tbilisi.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/71d4e250-d3ba-11f1-ad40-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/billet-retour-EN-1.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/71d4e250-d3ba-11f1-ad40-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/billet-retour-EN-1.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">cb199ede-d2eb-11f1-b617-d17d6f2c4016</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:34:51 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Maria GERTH-NICULESCU</dc:creator></item><item><category>Focus</category><title>Texas Republicans accused of changing electoral rules ahead of midterms</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/focus/20261030-texas-republicans-accused-of-changing-electoral-rules-ahead-of-midterms</link><description>
With the US midterm elections approaching, Republicans in Texas are being accused of changing electoral rules in their favour. In Tarrant County, near Dallas, they've cut the number of election-day polling places by nearly 30 percent. Virgin Galactic's first "Delta-class" space plane just made its maiden voyage.

The next-gen suborbital vehicle, named Apeiron (Greek for "Boundless"), lifted off for the first time ever on Thursday (Oct. 28). Flying beneath the wings of its carrier aircraft, VMS Eve, Apeiron traveled from Virgin's manufacturing site in Mesa, Arizona, to its launch site, Spaceport America in New Mexico.

"Seeing the ship fly beneath Eve to Spaceport America was a moment years in the making," Virgin Galactic CEO Michael Colglazier said in a statement on Thursday. "To our team and our astronaut community: your Spaceship has arrived."

Apeiron will undergo a series of checks and tests at Spaceport America, leading up to a planned start of commercial service in the spring of 2027.

During those customer flights, Eve will carry Apeiron to an altitude of about 45,000 feet (13,700 meters), then drop the space plane. Apeiron will fire up its onboard rocket motor, which will carry the six-passenger, two-pilot vehicle to suborbital space.

Passengers will experience a few minutes of weightlessness and get to see the curve of Earth against the blackness of space before coming down for a runway landing back at Spaceport America.

Virgin Galactic has done this before, with its VSS Unity space plane. Unity flew seven commercial suborbital missions during its operational life, which ran from June 2023 to June 2024.

Apeiron and other Delta-class planes are built for a much heavier workload, according to Virgin Galactic.

"Designed to fly twice per week with a vehicle lifetime of more than 500 missions, each Spaceship in the next-generation fleet is built to support the economics of a scaled commercial operation, with increased flight cadence and a cost profile unprecedented in the industry," company representatives wrote in the same statement.

And there will indeed be a fleet, if all goes to plan. The second Delta ship is under construction, for example, and is expected to enter service in mid-2027, according to Virgin Galactic.

Apeiron and its Delta-class siblings will need to fly a lot to deal with Virgin Galactic's backlog: Nearly 700 ticket-holders are currently waiting to fly, according to the company. And demand remains high; the latest batch of seats, which were priced at $750,000 apiece, sold out. Virgin plans to sell the next tranche of tickets for $850,000 each, LATTE Luxury News reported.

When Apeiron gets up and running, it will be the only game in town for suborbital space tourists.

Virgin Galactic once shared the skies with Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin, which flew paying customers to the final frontier on its New Shepard vehicle. New Shepard conducted 14 crewed suborbital flights between July 2021 and January 2026 but is currently grounded while the company focuses on helping NASA land Artemis astronauts on the moon.

Under favorable conditions, Shenlong is bright enough to spot with the naked eye, according to Spaceweather.com. But you'll need to set your alarm early, as some of the best viewing opportunities are in the predawn sky.

]]> <![CDATA[ Think Halloween is scary? This scorched alien world is a real-life cosmic horror story ]]> Earth would be terrifying if we celebrated Halloween every 11 hours, a possibility on a super-Earth investigated by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). That is, if this extrasolar planet, or exoplanet, wasn't so hellishly hot that no life could survive on its surface.

The exoplanet in question is the rocky lava planet TOI-561 b, located around 280 light-years away, which was discovered by NASA's exoplanet-hunting spacecraft TESS (Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite) in 2020. The planet is located so close to its star, TOI-561, that not only does it complete an orbit every 11 hours, but its surface temperatures reach in excess of 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit (1,800 degrees Celsius).

That is so hot that astronomers once believed that TOI-561 b couldn't possibly possess an atmosphere. With 37 hours of JWST observations covering nearly four full orbits of TOI-561, scientists have now found this horrific planet is buried in a reflective layer of vaporized silicate mineral clouds, the same family of compounds that make up quartz and sand.

"We measured how the planet's brightness and heat changed throughout its orbit," team member Lisa Dang of the University of Waterloo said in a statement. "This technique, known as a phase curve, revealed that the planet reflects a significant amount of light from its star, and that heat is being redistributed around the planet instead of only on the sunlit side. Together, these point to the presence of an atmosphere."

The hemispheres of lava super-Earth are day and night

On Oct. 29, 1991, the Galileo spacecraft flew by the asteroid Gaspra on its way to Jupiter. Gaspra was the first asteroid to ever be visited by a spacecraft.

Gaspra orbits near the inner edge of the asteroid belt. The Galileo spacecraft had been travelling through the asteroid belt for about two months before it reached Gaspra. Galileo was 990 miles (1,593 kilometers) away from Gaspra when it whizzed by, and it was travelling at a relative speed of about 5 miles (8 km) per second.

The spacecraft took several photos of the asteroid and used an instrument called the Near-Infrared Mapping Spectrometer to study its chemical composition and other physical properties. Galileo determined that Gaspra has an irregular and elongated shape measuring about 12 miles long and 7 miles wide. The images revealed that Gaspra was also covered in craters. Because Galileo was too far away for Gaspra's gravity to affect it, the spacecraft was not able to determine the asteroid's mass.

Why it mattered

The Galileo spacecraft's flyby of Gaspra was a pitstop near the midpoint of its 6-year journey to Jupiter, the largest planet in our solar system. NASA launched Galileo toward Jupiter in October 1989, with the probe swinging by Venus and Earth in 1990 before its encounter with Gaspra.

The Gaspra flyby was the first asteroid flyby in history, with Galileo approaching to just under 1,000 miles (1,601 kilometers) while flying at a whopping 18,000 mph. Galileo's photos of Gaspra "revealed a cratered, complex, irregular body about 20 by 12 by 11 kilometers (12.4 by 7.4 by 6.8 miles), with a thin covering of dust and rubble," NASA wrote in an overview.

"The picture we get of Gaspra is one of something that has suffered a lot during its history," the UPI press service quoted Joseph Veverka, a Galileo imaging team member, as saying at the time. "We suspect that this is the survivor of a series of catastrophic collisions in the past."

Galileo would go on to fly by Earth a second time in 1992, then swing close by the asteroid Ida in 1993 before finally arriving at Jupiter in 1995. Along the way, the probe was in the right place at the right time to watch as the Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 broke into pieces and crashed into Jupiter in July 1994.

Since Galileo's historic first asteroid flyby, NASA and other space agencies have gone on to land on asteroids (like NEAR on asteroid Eros), collect samples of asteroids and return them to Earth (like NASA's OSIRIS-REx and Japan's Hayabusa probes), and have even intentionally crashed probes into asteroids (like NASA's DART asteroid impact mission) to test planetary protection techniques.

]]> <![CDATA[ Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman named deputy director for NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory ]]> The leader of NASA's first mission around the moon in half a century is the last to announce what's next for him after retiring from active astronaut duty.

All four astronauts of the Artemis II mission, which flew around the moon in April, have hung up their spacesuits and moved on to greener pastures. NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), managed by Caltech, announced yesterday that former NASA astronaut Reid Wiseman will step into the role of Caltech associate vice president and deputy director of JPL, beginning Nov. 30.

"Reid has spent his career at the edge of what is possible, and he has the technical judgment, operational experience, and leadership to help push that edge farther," NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said in a JPL press release.

Wiseman announced his transition to "astronaut emeritus" alongside Artemis II pilot Victor Glover in September. Glover, subsequently, accepted a full-time role as executive advisor to the president of his alma mater, California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly).

Artemis II mission specialists, Christina Koch and Canada's Jeremy Hansen, also made the decision to step away from their spaceflight careers. Hansen announced his career change in July, and has since entered into reservist duty with the Royal Canadian Air Force. Koch, more recently, was appointed as NASA's acting deputy chief engineer, effective Nov. 1.

The quartet launched aboard NASA's Orion capsule on April 1, and completed a 10-day flight around the far side of the moon and back. Their mission took them further from Earth than any crewed spaceflight in history, and captured the attention of millions, who were captivated by the astronauts' incredible views and their ability to demonstrate the best traits of humanity, even while being the four people farthest from it.

The mission served as a stepping stone in NASA's Artemis program which aims to return astronauts to the surface of the moon and eventually establish a permanent base there. NASA is targeting mid-2027 for Artemis III as a flight test with Orion and the two Artemis lunar lander spacecraft (SpaceX's Starship and Blue Origin's Blue Moon). If everything goes according to plan, that mission will pave the way for Artemis IV, and the program's first crewed lunar landing in 2028.

A Baltimore native, Wiseman is a retired U.S. Navy captain who served as an aviator and test pilot before joining NASA's astronaut corps in 2009. He launched to space for the first time on the on the Soyuz TMA-13M mission to the International Space Station (ISS). He spent 165 days in orbit serving as part of ISS Expeditions 40 and 41, and completed two spacewalks totaling nearly 13 hours.

Before his selection for Artemis II, Wiseman worked as NASA's chief astronaut, overseeing crew readiness, astronaut assignments and flight safety from Dec. 2020 - Nov. 2022.

As JPL's new deputy director, Wiseman will serve under Director Dave Gallagher, helping oversee "strategic leadership, stewardship, and continuous improvement of laboratory operations," according to the JPL release.

JPL is a federally funded research and development center specializing in robotic space exploration. The lab is responsible for some of NASA's most recognizable planetary missions, including the Perseverance and Curiosity Mars rovers, Europa Clipper and the Voyager probes. JPL also operates NASA's Deep Space Network, which provides continuous communications with spacecraft throughout the solar system.

"I've explored the furthest reaches of what a human can explore at NASA — and there were truly no words in the English vocabulary to describe seeing the sun disappear behind the moon from deep space," Wiseman said.

"But that experience was really the jumping off point to go do the impossible things that Caltech and JPL dream, dare together, and do for NASA and the nation.”

The 10-by-2-by-4-foot (3-by-0.6-by-1.2-meter) rolled-up assembly was delivered to the space station inside the unpressurized trunk of SpaceX's Dragon cargo capsule earlier this month, on the company's 35th ISS resupply mission for NASA.

Menon then secured himself at the end of the Canadarm2 robotic arm and carried the 750-pound (340-kilogram) iROSA to the space station's port side, where he and Kutryk next installed it on the 2A electrical power channel. Kutryk made his way to the worksite along the station's backbone truss.

While they believe Jason to be dead, they're able to revive Rowan using nanotechnology. As it so happens, Jason isn't dead at all (what a shocker); he was just catching up on some sleep and dreaming about stuffing teens in sleeping bags and whacking them against each other. He rises from his slumber and goes on a killing spree in the spaceship.

They turn the movie's android KM-14 (played by Lisa Ryder of "Andromeda" fame) into a Rambo-esque action hero in the third act, whereby she annihilates Jason with a combination of hokey martial arts moves and ridiculously overpowered weapons.

Most importantly, though, it's never afraid to embrace the shlock and humor that's evidently part of its DNA. "Jason X" is a B-movie through and through, and it waters its roots to grow wilder rather than hide or trim them down.

For instance, when Condor (Steve Lucescu) fights against Jason, he throws a bunch of stiff attacks at Crystal Lake's most famous citizen. However, Jason simply pushes him into a giant drill that's conveniently placed there (where are the health and safety regulations on the Grendel?!).

What "Jason X" represents is a different time in Hollywood, when studios and filmmakers weren't afraid to take outlandish risks with their franchises. Think about it: What else was there left for "Friday the 13th" to do? Let Jason murder more teens who cross his path?

Instead of just repeating the same formula over and over again, these filmmakers decided to think outside of the box and venture into an unexpected direction. Whether you like it or not, you have to appreciate the commitment to trying something new and reinventing the franchise.

When all is said and done, "Crystal Lake" will be remembered as a more cerebral examination of the Voorhees family, but "Jason X" might be seen as the pinnacle of creativity in the series that's never going to be reached again. It's so goofy and silly, but the concept of taking an unkillable killer, chucking him into space, and making him a cyborg deserves a standing ovation.

We're once again left wondering: Why aren't we making horror movies like this anymore?

]]> <![CDATA[ See NASA's Artemis III astronauts meet Trump at the White House as they train for a critical 2027 moon lander test flight (photos) ]]> U.S. President Donald Trump just met another NASA Artemis crew.

The astronauts of NASA's Artemis III mission visited the Oval Office on Thursday (Oct. 28) and posed for a few photos with the president.

Their visit came nearly six months to the day after that of the Artemis II crew, who stopped by the White House on April 29, 19 days after the end of their historic flight around the moon.

The Artemis III astronauts are NASA's Randy Bresnik (commander), Andre Douglas and Frank Rubio (mission specialists) and the European Space Agency's Luca Parmitano (pilot). All four — plus backup crewmate Bob Hines of NASA, and agency chief Jared Isaacman — made the White House trip.

"It was a great day at the White House with President Trump and the talented crew of Artemis III," Isaacman wrote via X on Thursday.

Artemis III will launch to low Earth orbit in the summer of 2027, if all goes according to plan. The roughly two-week-long mission will aim to dock NASA's Orion capsule with SpaceX's Starship vehicle and/or Blue Origin's Blue Moon.

NASA selected Starship and Blue Moon to be the crewed lunar landers for the Artemis program, so Artemis III will provide valuable practice: On moon-landing missions, astronauts will launch aboard Orion and then meet up with either Starship or Blue Moon, which will carry them to the lunar surface and back up again.

That's slated to happen for the first time on Artemis IV, which NASA plans to launch in 2028.

We don't yet know which private lander(s) will launch on Artemis III; NASA would like to fly both of them, but it's unclear if both will be ready when the time comes.

That uncertainty applies to Artemis IV as well. We'll have to wait a bit before we know which spacecraft will have the honor of putting astronauts down on the moon for the first time since Apollo 17 in 1972.

]]> <![CDATA[ Cosmic graveyard of zombie planets offers a grisly warning about our own solar system's fate ]]> "Sometimes dead is better." Who can forget the immortal words of Jud Crandall, delivered by the incomparable Fred Gwynne in the 1989 film adaptation of Stephen King's Pet Sematary? Turns out Crandall could have been talking about somewhere just as otherworldly as the cursed Chumash burial ground at the heart of one of King's most terrifying works of fiction.

That's because astronomers have discovered two husks of two zombie planets shuffling through the gory remains of what was once their planetary neighbors around a long-deceased star, or white dwarf. The shattered planets were revealed by a clear gap in the debris around the white dwarf J1328−1450, located around 1,600 light-years away from Earth. One of the remnants is estimated to be no larger than the size of the average solar system asteroid, while the other is estimated to be between the size of the moon and the dwarf planet Pluto.

If this wasn't creepy enough, this haunting planetary system could be a grisly warning about the future of our own solar system after the inevitable death of the sun.

White dwarfs like the one at the heart of this system are formed when stars around the same mass as the sun run out of hydrogen in their cores. This means they can no longer fuse hydrogen into helium, the nuclear fusion process that provides the outward push that supports a star against the inward push of its own gravity.

As a result, the stars' cores collapse while the outer layers, where nuclear fusion is still proceeding, puff out. This so-called red giant phase can see stars increase their radius by many 100s of times. When it happens to the sun in around 5 billion years, our star will expand to consume the inner planets, including Earth.

The red giant phase ends when the outer layers disperse along with the wreckage of consumed planets, leaving a smoldering stellar core, now a white dwarf, surrounded by the disk-shaped remains of its outer layers and cannibalized planetary children. But this may not be the final death of all the planets that once orbited the now-dead star.

"We have known for some time that planets may survive beyond the transformation of their central star, but this is the first example of a complex system with a double debris disc and potentially two surviving planetesimals," research leader Nicola Gentille Fusillo, an astronomer at the Università degli Studi di Trieste, Italy, said in a statement.

Violent stellar death can't kill these two planetary Jason Voorhees

This system differs from others seen because of the large gap between the remarkably stable inner and outer rings. All previously known debris discs around white dwarfs have been surrounded by single, flat, rotating disks, not a double structure like this.

"The system is a rare glimpse of the violent, chaotic process by which a planetary system meets its end, and it hints that dead stars can have disc structures far more complex than previously realized," team member Gentle Fusillo of the Astronomical Observatory of Trieste said.

The team thinks that this unique double structure is evidence of planets that weren't completely vaporized during this white dwarf's red giant phase.

That means just like the residents and campers of Crystal Lake couldn't finish off Pamela Voorhees' baby boy, even an expanding star couldn't finish these two planets.

The team's observations, made with the Very Large Telescope (VLT), revealed the presence of calcium, oxygen, magnesium, and iron in the disk around the white dwarf. This indicates the destroyed planets had a composition similar to the rocky planets of the inner solar system.

The researchers also found evidence of a diversity of composition in the destroyed planets. The chemistry of the outer rings deviated from that of the inner rings, indicating that at least two of the consumed planets had very different compositions.

"The system therefore offers a remarkable glimpse of what the future of planetary systems, including systems like our own, might look like," Lagos-Vilches explained.

The team's research was published on Monday (Oct. 26) in the journal Nature Astronomy.

   <description>„Já jsem nikdy nechtěla vyloženě umřít. Chtěla jsem na chvíli přestat existovat.“ Jana Vítová byla podle maminky nejšťastnějším dítětem pod sluncem. V šesti letech zažila sexuální zneužití, ve třinácti první panickou ataku a později období, kdy nevěřila, že se dožije třiadvaceti let. Dnes stojí za projektem ataka.space a mluví o naději, kterou kdysi sama nedokázala vidět.  <description>Benjamin Netanjahu podle dosavadních výsledků izraelských voleb přišel o parlamentní většinu, přesto může zůstat premiérem. Ani jeho odpůrci totiž bez arabských stran většinu nemají a na spolupráci s nimi se neshodnou. „Netanjahu volby prohrál v tom smyslu, že jeho vláda už nemá většinu. Ale zároveň tu není žádný alternativní vítěz,“ říká politolog Noam Gidron z Hebrejské univerzity v Jeruzalémě. Ve hře je podle něj široká koalice i další volby.</description>

<item>
 <title>Izrael zná výsledky parlamentních voleb. Zvítězila Netanjahuova koalice, většinu ale nemá</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/izrael-zna-vysledky-parlamentnich-voleb-zvitezila-netanjahuova-koalice-vetsinu_2610300734_zko</link>
 <description>Izraelská volební komise v noci zveřejnila konečné výsledky úterních parlamentních voleb, nadpoloviční většinu hlasů ve 120-členném Knesetu v nich nezískala ani současná vládní koalice, ani strany opozice. V souladu s předběžnými výsledky budou mít strany dosavadní koalice premiéra Benjamina Netanjahua 53 křesel, blok 4 opozičních stran 48 poslanců a zbývajících 19 mandátů připadne arabským stranám. Informoval o tom server The Times of Israel.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2018-01-03t095217z_1_180103-124703_haf.jpg?itok=rAMAsQXc" type="image/jpeg" />

 <title>Ukrajina měla pozastavit útoky na ruské rafinerie. K jejich obnovení ale došlo dříve, než Trump vyžadoval</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-po-tlaku-trumpa-ukrajina-pozastavila-udery-na-ruske-rafinerie-pise_2610300721_jor</link>
 <description>Ukrajinská armáda po týdnech tlaku ze strany amerického prezidenta Donalda Trumpa minulý týden pozastavila vzdušné údery na ruské rafinerie. Napsal to ve čtvrtek večer list The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) s odvoláním na osoby obeznámené s vojenskými operacemi. Pauza v útocích měla podle listu trvat do 3. listopadu, kdy se v USA konají volby do Kongresu. Kyjev ji ale oficiálně neoznámil a v pátek útoky opět obnovil.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-08-13t070108z_8_260814-150450_jva.JPG?itok=d8ssnm5j" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Temné peníze a zákeřné reklamy. Volby příští týden budou nejdražší v historii</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/temne-penize-a-zakerne-reklamy-volby-pristi-tyden-budou-nejdrazsi-v-historii_2610300620_vdv</link>
 <description>Výdaje narostly a federální dohled je menší. Letošní volby do Kongresu budou ve Spojených státech dle odhadů ty nejdražší v historii. Nechat se zvolit do federálního úřadu je čím dál tím dražší a Američané volají po etické reformě. V pátém díle seriálu Midterms 2026 sledujeme trendy v politických reklamách i největší přispěvatele. Tím je letos bezkonkurenčně miliardář Elon Musk.</description>

V Libereckém kraji se změna týká jedenácti prodejen</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904455-majitel-albertu-kupuje-tesco-v-hradci-se-zmena-tyka-ctyr-prodejen.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904455-majitel-albertu-kupuje-tesco-v-hradci-se-zmena-tyka-ctyr-prodejen.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 14:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Markéta Hamerníková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>České a slovenské Tesco kupuje skupina Ahold Delhaize, která provozuje Albert. V Liberci má Tesco tři prodejny, v kraji jich je jedenáct. Převzetí ještě musí schválit úřady, dokončení se očekává na konci roku 2027.</description></item><item><title>Podzim v Libereckém kraji opět patří dopravní výchově</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/904191-podzim-v-libereckem-kraji-opet-patri-dopravni-vychove.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/904191-podzim-v-libereckem-kraji-opet-patri-dopravni-vychove.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:54:00 +0100</pubDate><category>Doprava</category><description>Program Dny s dopravní výchovou se letos na podzim vrací do Libereckého kraje ve větším rozsahu. Tým silniční bezpečnosti stráví 27 dnů v mateřských školkách a 21 dnů v základních školách. Děti získají praktické dovednosti i reflexní prvky, díky kterým budou v podzimní tmě lépe vidět.</description></item><item><title>Nový senátor Půta se nejspíš stane i starostou Hrádku nad Nisou</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904436-novy-senator-puta-se-nejspis-stane-i-starostou-hradku-nad-nisou.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904436-novy-senator-puta-se-nejspis-stane-i-starostou-hradku-nad-nisou.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:02:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Nově zvolený senátor Martin Půta sice oznámil, že se vzdá postu libereckého hejtmana, zároveň se ale nejspíš stane po 14 letech starostou příhraničního Hrádku nad Nisou na Liberecku. Na sociální síti facebook Půta oznámil, že je kandidátem na starostu za sdružení Hrádek potřebuje změny!.</description></item><item><title>Lipo zpívá s dětmi ze Severáčku: Dojemná novinka vzpomíná na Stypku i Slováčkovou</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/904406-lipo-zpiva-s-detmi-ze-severacku-dojemna-novinka-vzpomina-na-stypku-i-slovackovou.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/904406-lipo-zpiva-s-detmi-ze-severacku-dojemna-novinka-vzpomina-na-stypku-i-slovackovou.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:54:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Kultura</category><description>Liberecký hudebník Lipo vydává videoklip k písni Vlaštovky, na které spojil síly s dětským sborem Severáček. Osobní skladba plná naděje a vděčnosti vzpomíná na zesnulé přátele, jako byli Anna Julie Slováčková a David Stypka, a ukazuje život v jeho přirozené kráse.</description></item><item><title>Petřík (6) z Liberce bojuje se svalovou dystrofií. Podpořte jeho boj koupí samolepky</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904402-petrik-6-z-liberce-bojuje-se-svalovou-dystrofii-podporte-jeho-boj-koupi-samolepky.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904402-petrik-6-z-liberce-bojuje-se-svalovou-dystrofii-podporte-jeho-boj-koupi-samolepky.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 06:30:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Šestiletý Petřík z Liberce bojuje s vážnou Duchennovou svalovou dystrofií. Náročná péče, rehabilitace a lázně mu pomáhají zůstat co nejdéle samostatným. Podpořte ho v rámci sbírky Srdce dětem – nákupem samolepky v Lidlu nebo příspěvkem na účet. Pomůžete zlepšit život jemu i dalším nemocným dětem.</description></item><item><title>Policejní lov na neukázněné řidiče: Podívejte se, za co nejvíce padaly pokuty</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/904393-policejni-lov-na-neukaznene-ridice-podivejte-se-za-co-nejvice-padaly-pokuty.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/904393-policejni-lov-na-neukaznene-ridice-podivejte-se-za-co-nejvice-padaly-pokuty.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 19:13:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Dopravní policisté v kraji si posvítili na řidiče, kteří riskují na železničních přejezdech i silnicích. Během týdenních kontrol rozdali pokuty za víc než sto tisíc korun za ignorování značek, telefonování za volantem či jízdu bez bezpečnostních pásů.</description></item><item><title>Opilý elektrokoloběžkář při jízdě po chodníku narazil do sloupu. Těžce se zranil</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904391-opily-elektrokolobezkar-pri-jizde-po-chodniku-narazil-do-sloupu-tezce-se-zranil.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904391-opily-elektrokolobezkar-pri-jizde-po-chodniku-narazil-do-sloupu-tezce-se-zranil.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 17:55:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Těžkým zraněním skončila v pondělí v České Lípě jízda devětatřicetiletého muže na elektrokoloběžce. Na sídlišti Sever jel po chodníku a pod vlivem alkoholu nezvládl odbočení a narazil do sloupu veřejného osvětlení. V krvi měl 1,4 promile a hrozí mu vysoká pokuta.</description></item><item><title>Vražda v Jablonci: Obviněný muž se s obětí znal, soud ho poslal do vazby</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904399-vrazda-v-jablonci-obvineny-muz-se-s-obeti-znal-soud-ho-poslal-do-vazby.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/904399-vrazda-v-jablonci-obvineny-muz-se-s-obeti-znal-soud-ho-poslal-do-vazby.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:36:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Prověrka úmrtí muže v jabloneckém panelovém domě odhalila vraždu. Kriminalisté zadrželi podezřelého, kterého soud ve středu poslal do vazební věznice. Oba muži se znali. Podle policie veřejnosti nehrozí žádné nebezpečí.</description></item><item><title>FOTO: Vypuštěný Vesecký rybník v Liberci odhalil dno. Proč zasáhly bagry?</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904382-foto-vypusteny-vesecky-rybnik-v-liberci-odhalil-dno-proc-zasahly-bagry.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904382-foto-vypusteny-vesecky-rybnik-v-liberci-odhalil-dno-proc-zasahly-bagry.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:27:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Vesecký rybník na jižním okraji Liberce, známý jako Tajch, je vypuštěný a připravený na celkovou obnovu. Podívejte se na fotografie odkrytého dna vyfocené z dronu z výšky. Chystaná rekonstrukce zvýší bezpečnost vodního díla při povodních a přinese i odtěžení tisíců kubíků nánosů.</description></item><item><title>ANO přišlo o své zastupitele v Turnově, budou vystupovat jako nezařazení</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904365-ano-prislo-o-sve-zastupitele-v-turnove-budou-vystupovat-jako-nezarazeni.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904365-ano-prislo-o-sve-zastupitele-v-turnove-budou-vystupovat-jako-nezarazeni.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Hnutí ANO přišlo po Semilech o své městské zastupitele také v Turnově, budou vystupovat jako nezařazení. Zároveň zanikla místní buňka ANO v Turnově. Lídr turnovské kandidátky ANO Jaroslav Knížek (býv. ANO) to ČTK zdůvodnil tím, že nechtějí být zatíženi celostátní politikou.</description></item></channel></rss>

výběžek.eu https://www.vybezek.eu dobrý den ze šluknovského výběžku, konce světa - šluknovský výběžek Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:47:35 +0000 cs hourly 1 https://wordpress.org/?v=7.1.4 https://www.vybezek.eu/wp-uploads/2018/09/cropped-favicon-vybezek-32x32.png výběžek.eu https://www.vybezek.eu 32 32 Mandava Jazz / Mandau Jazz 2026 – Iva Bittová & Duo Jedlinský–Fischer https://www.vybezek.eu/296291-mandava-jazz-mandau-jazz-2026-iva-bittova-duo-jedlinsky-fischer/ Thu, 29 Oct 2026 18:16:24 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296291 Další večer u Kocoura – Mezinárodní hudební festival Mandava Jazz 2026 tentokrát ve středu 28. září 2026, opět ve varnsdorfském pivovaru Kocour, dorazila Iva Bittová a duo Jedlinský & Fischer.

Stejně jako nedávného Dana Bártu i Ivu Bittovou jsme už zažili několikrát (2011 na Vlčí hoře nebo 2017 v divadle). Vždy jako personu velmi osobitou, která si s nástrojem, hlasem a jazykem (nebo spíš jazyky, chvílemi to vypadalo na hudební esperanto-svahilštinu), dělá co chce. A vždy bravurně. Ačkoli ona sama je většinou tahákem na plakátech a v upoutávkách, sama sebe neupřednostňuje a dává spoustu prostoru všem, se kterými v tu kterou chvíli spolupracuje.
